# dgesc2

> Solves a system of linear equations using the LU factorization with complete pivoting computed by sgetc2.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import dgesc2 from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/dgesc2';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
dgesc2(
    order,
    N,
    A, LDA,
    RHS, strideRHS,
    IPIV, strideIPIV,
    JPIV, strideJPIV,
    scale
) → Float64Array
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order` | `Layout` | Storage layout ('row-major' or 'column-major') |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | The order of the matrix A. |
| `A` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>N × N</sub> | On entry, the LU part of the factorization of the n-by-n matrix A computed by DGETC2: A = P \* L \* U \* Q. |
| ↳ `LDA` | `PositiveInteger` | Leading dimension of `A` |
| `RHS` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | **in/out** · On entry, the right hand side vector b. On exit, the solution vector X. |
| ↳ `strideRHS` | `integer` | Stride length for `RHS` |
| `IPIV` | `Int32Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | The pivot indices; for 1 <= i <= N, row i of the matrix has been interchanged with row IPIV(i) (0-based). |
| ↳ `strideIPIV` | `integer` | Stride length for `IPIV` |
| `JPIV` | `Int32Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | The pivot indices; for 1 <= j <= N, column j of the matrix has been interchanged with column JPIV(j) (0-based). |
| ↳ `strideJPIV` | `integer` | Stride length for `JPIV` |
| `scale` | `Float64Array` | **out** · On exit, SCALE contains the scale factor. |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `N`: The order of the matrix A.
- `A`: On entry, the LU part of the factorization of the n-by-n matrix A computed by DGETC2: $A = P \, L \, U \, Q$
- `RHS`: On entry, the right hand side vector b. On exit, the solution vector X.
- `IPIV`: The pivot indices; for $1 \le i \le N$, row i of the matrix has been interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`.
- `JPIV`: The pivot indices; for $1 \le j \le N$, column j of the matrix has been interchanged with column `JPIV(j)`.
- `scale`: On exit, `SCALE` contains the scale factor. `SCALE` is chosen $0 \le \mathrm{SCALE} \le 1$ to prevent overflow in the solution.

</details>

**Returns** `Float64Array`: `RHS`

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid order

### Strided (strided) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
dgesc2.strided(
    N,
    A, strideA1, strideA2, offsetA,
    RHS, strideRHS, offsetRHS,
    IPIV, strideIPIV, offsetIPIV,
    JPIV, strideJPIV, offsetJPIV,
    scale
) → Float64Array
```

Solves a system of linear equations A _ X = scale _ RHS with a general.
N-by-N matrix A using the LU factorization with complete pivoting computed
by dgetc2.

IPIV and JPIV are 0-based pivot indices from dgetc2.

Matrix shapes are logical (rows × columns). The reference's leading dimension (`LDA`, …) is replaced by the two strides and the offset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the matrix A |
| `A` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>N × N</sub> | LU-factored N-by-N matrix from dgetc2 |
| ↳ `strideA1` | `integer` | Stride of the first dimension of A |
| ↳ `strideA2` | `integer` | Stride of the second dimension of A |
| ↳ `offsetA` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for A |
| `RHS` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | **in/out** · Right-hand side vector (overwritten with solution) |
| ↳ `strideRHS` | `integer` | Stride for RHS |
| ↳ `offsetRHS` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for RHS |
| `IPIV` | `Int32Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | Row pivot indices from dgetc2, 0-based |
| ↳ `strideIPIV` | `integer` | Stride for IPIV |
| ↳ `offsetIPIV` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for IPIV |
| `JPIV` | `Int32Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | Column pivot indices from dgetc2, 0-based |
| ↳ `strideJPIV` | `integer` | Stride for JPIV |
| ↳ `offsetJPIV` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for JPIV |
| `scale` | `Float64Array` | **out** · Output: scale[0] receives the scaling factor |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `N`: The order of the matrix A.
- `A`: On entry, the LU part of the factorization of the n-by-n matrix A computed by DGETC2: $A = P \, L \, U \, Q$
- `RHS`: On entry, the right hand side vector b. On exit, the solution vector X.
- `IPIV`: The pivot indices; for $1 \le i \le N$, row i of the matrix has been interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`.
- `JPIV`: The pivot indices; for $1 \le j \le N$, column j of the matrix has been interchanged with column `JPIV(j)`.
- `scale`: On exit, `SCALE` contains the scale factor. `SCALE` is chosen $0 \le \mathrm{SCALE} \le 1$ to prevent overflow in the solution.

</details>

**Returns** `Float64Array`: `RHS`

</section>

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   `dgesc2()` corresponds to the reference LAPACK routine [`DGESC2`](https://github.com/Reference-LAPACK/lapack/blob/v3.12.0/SRC/dgesc2.f).

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import Float64Array from '@stdlib/array/float64/lib/index.js';
import Int32Array from '@stdlib/array/int32/lib/index.js';
import dgetc2 from './../../dgetc2/lib/index.js';
import dgesc2 from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/dgesc2';

const N = 3;

// Column-major, nonsingular 3-by-3 matrix:
const A0 = [ 4.0, 1.0, 2.0, 1.0, 5.0, 1.0, 2.0, 1.0, 6.0 ];

// Factor A with complete pivoting:
const A = new Float64Array( A0 );
const IPIV = new Int32Array( N );
const JPIV = new Int32Array( N );
dgetc2( 'column-major', N, A, N, IPIV, 1, JPIV, 1 );
const scale = new Float64Array( 1 );

// Using the standard interface (solve A*x = scale*b):
let RHS = new Float64Array( [ 7.0, 7.0, 9.0 ] );
dgesc2( 'column-major', N, A, N, RHS, 1, IPIV, 1, JPIV, 1, scale );
console.log( RHS, scale ); // eslint-disable-line no-console

// Using the strided interface:
RHS = new Float64Array( [ 7.0, 7.0, 9.0 ] );
dgesc2.strided( N, A, 1, N, 0, RHS, 1, 0, IPIV, 1, 0, JPIV, 1, 0, scale );
console.log( RHS, scale ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->

<section class="reference-notes">

## Reference notes

The mathematical description from the reference LAPACK 3.12.0 source of `DGESC2`. Indices are the 1-based Fortran indices of the source.

### Purpose

DGESC2 solves a system of linear equations

$A \, X$ = scale\* `RHS`

with a general N-by-N matrix A using the LU factorization with complete pivoting computed by DGETC2.

</section>
